articles.author: Snigdha Gairola
articles.headline: Anthony Scaramucci Says Trump Has 'No Economic Philosophy,' Warns He Is On Pace To Spend $10 Trillion In Second Term
articles.summary: Scaramucci criticized Trump’s economic policy, warning rising U.S. debt and spending could fuel inflation and deepen inequality.
articles._summary: Former White House communications director Anthony Scaramucci criticized President Donald Trump’s economic approach, arguing that rising federal spending and debt levels are pushing the U.S. toward inflation risks and potential financial instability. On Saturday, in a post on X , Scaramucci said Trump "has no economic philosophy" and pointed to surging federal spending across administrations. He said Trump oversaw $8.2 trillion in spending during his first term and is on pace for $9 trillion to $10 trillion in the current term. "We’re at 100% debt to GDP held by investors. 122% if you count the Fed’s balance sheet," he wrote, adding that such levels resemble conditions linked to sovereign debt stress. He also cited investor Ray Dalio , saying high debt typically forces governments toward inflation as an easier way to manage obligations.
articles._zh_headline: 安东尼·斯卡拉穆奇称特朗普“没有经济哲学”，并警告称他将在第二个任期内花费 10 万亿美元
articles._zh_summary: 前白宫通讯主管安东尼·斯卡拉穆奇批评唐纳德·特朗普总统的经济方针，认为联邦支出和债务水平的上升正在将美国推向通胀风险和潜在的金融不稳定。周六，斯卡拉穆奇在 X 上发帖称，特朗普“没有经济哲学”，并指出历届政府的联邦支出激增。他表示，特朗普在第一个任期内监督了 8.2 万亿美元的支出，当前任期内的支出有望达到 9 万亿至 10 万亿美元。他写道：“投资者持有的债务占 GDP 的比例为 100%。如果算上美联储的资产负债表，则为 122%。”他补充说，这样的水平类似于与主权债务压力相关的情况。他还援引投资者雷·达利奥(Ray Dalio)的话说，高额债务通常会迫使政府将通胀作为管理债务的更简单方式。

articles.author: Snigdha Gairola
articles.headline: Adam Schiff Slams Trump, Says Americans Paid $60 Billion More For Gas During Iran War: 'Everything Is Going Up, Up, Up'
articles.summary: Sen. Adam Schiff says Iran war is raising U.S. costs, citing higher gas prices and inflation while questioning a $300B reconstruction plan.
articles._summary: Sen. Adam Schiff (D-Calif.) said the ongoing conflict with Iran has driven up costs for American families, arguing that higher gas prices and broader inflation are being felt nationwide while criticizing a proposed foreign reconstruction plan. On Saturday, in a post on X alongside a speech clip, Schiff wrote, "Since the start of the Iran War, our costs at home have gone higher and higher." He said that President Donald Trump is not doing enough to ease economic pressure, instead offering Iran a $300 billion reconstruction fund. "This is hardly what people were expecting from a president promising America first," he added. In the accompanying clip, Schiff said Americans have paid "$60 billion more for gas" during the conflict and argued that global instability has pushed up prices across the economy. "You paid $60 billion more for gas during the war," he said in the clip.
articles._zh_headline: 亚当·希夫猛烈抨击特朗普，称美国人在伊朗战争期间为天然气多支付了 600 亿美元：“一切都在上涨、上涨、上涨”
articles._zh_summary: 加利福尼亚州民主党参议员亚当·希夫表示，与伊朗的持续冲突推高了美国家庭的成本，他认为全国范围内都感受到了汽油价格上涨和更广泛的通货膨胀，同时批评了一项拟议的外国重建计划。周六，希夫在 X 上的一篇帖子和一段演讲片段中写道，“自伊朗战争爆发以来，我们在国内的成本越来越高。”他表示，特朗普总统在缓解经济压力方面做得不够，反而向伊朗提供了3000亿美元的重建基金。他补充道：“人们很难想象一位承诺美国优先的总统会做出这样的事情。”希夫在随附的视频中表示，冲突期间美国人“为天然气多支付了 600 亿美元”，并认为全球不稳定推高了整个经济领域的价格。 “战争期间你为天​​然气多支付了 600 亿美元，”他在视频中说道。

articles.headline: Lebanese turtle conservationist Mona Khalil killed by Israeli strike
articles.summary: Mona Khalil, who had refused to leave the beach she had spent years protecting, died after several days in hospital, an environmental group said.
articles._summary: Lebanese environmental activist Mona Khalil, whose work helped turn a stretch of coastline in southern Lebanon into one of the eastern Mediterranean's most important nesting sites for endangered sea turtles, has died after being wounded in an Israeli strike. Khalil, 76, was injured when her house on Mansouri beach, near the southern city of Tyre, was hit during Israeli attacks in southern Lebanon two weeks ago. She died on Friday after several days in hospital, according to a local environmental group. Her death came as Israeli air strikes intensified across southern Lebanon, raising concerns about renewed violence despite diplomatic efforts to maintain a fragile regional peace. The BBC has reached out to the Israeli military for a response. "She is a deeply committed environmental defender," Hisham Younes, the founder and president of Green Southerners, told the BBC.
articles._zh_headline: 黎巴嫩海龟保护主义者莫娜·哈利勒在以色列袭击中丧生
articles._zh_summary: 黎巴嫩环保活动人士莫娜·哈利勒在以色列的一次袭击中受伤后去世，她的工作帮助将黎巴嫩南部的一段海岸线变成了地中海东部最重要的濒危海龟筑巢地之一。两周前，以色列对黎巴嫩南部发动袭击，76 岁的哈利勒位于南部城市提尔附近曼苏里海滩的房屋遭到袭击，她受伤。据当地环保组织称，她在医院几天后于周五去世。她去世之际，以色列加强了对黎巴嫩南部的空袭，引发了人们对暴力事件再次发生的担忧，尽管外交努力维持了脆弱的地区和平。 BBC 已联系以色列军方寻求回应。 “她是一位坚定的环保卫士，”绿色南方人组织的创始人兼总裁希沙姆·尤尼斯 (Hisham Younes) 告诉英国广播公司 (BBC)。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Crude Oil Price Pops As Iran Closes Strait Of Hormuz
articles.summary: Brent and WTI crude oil benchmarks are rising today after Iran closed the Strait of Hormuz following the ongoing fighting in Lebanon.
articles._summary: Crude oil prices jumped today, June 20, on popular perpetual futures marketplaces like Hyperliquid and Aster, after Iran announced the sudden closure of the Strait of Hormuz. WTI jumped to $79, while Brent rose to $82. The two popular benchmarks have risen by 7% from their lowest levels this month. Iran has closed the Strait of Hormuz, citing the ongoing skirmishes in Lebanon and Gaza. This closure happened after Israel continued its strikes against Lebanon, killing at least 16 people. According to Reuters , Israel said that its strikes in South Lebanon were a response to Hezbollah attacks. It noted that Hezbollah launched over 50 projectiles towards Israel. At the same time, Hezbollah said that it would not allow Israel "freedom of movement" in Lebanon. Iran closed the Strait of Hormuz because peace in Lebanon is one of the 14 points of the deal that President Donald Trump and his Iranian counterpart signed this week.
articles._zh_headline: 伊朗关闭霍尔木兹海峡，原油价格上涨
articles._zh_summary: 伊朗宣布突然关闭霍尔木兹海峡后，6 月 20 日，Hyperliquid 和 Aster 等热门永续期货市场上的原油价格大幅上涨。 WTI 涨至 79 美元，布伦特原油涨至 82 美元。这两个受欢迎的基准指数较本月最低水平上涨了 7%。伊朗以黎巴嫩和加沙地带持续发生的小冲突为由，关闭了霍尔木兹海峡。此次关闭是在以色列继续袭击黎巴嫩并造成至少 16 人死亡之后发生的。据路透社报道，以色列表示，对黎巴嫩南部的袭击是对真主党袭击的回应。报告指出，真主党向以色列发射了 50 多枚射弹。与此同时，真主党表示不会允许以色列在黎巴嫩“行动自由”。伊朗关闭霍尔木兹海峡，因为黎巴嫩和平是唐纳德·特朗普总统和伊朗总统本周签署的协议的 14 点之一。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Top BofA Analyst Explains Why Sandisk Has More Upside After 4,755% Surge
articles.summary: Sandisk stock has soared since its spin off, and analysts at Bank of America believe that it has more upside to go in the near term.
articles._summary: Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK ) has been the best-performing company in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 indices this year. It has soared by 800% since January, and is up by 4,755% in the last 12 months. This surge has turned it from a small Western Digital (NASDAQ: WDC ) spin-off into a $323 billion company. And in a recent note, a Bank of America analyst predicted that it has more upside to go. Wamsi Mohan, a top BofA analyst believes that Sandisk’s shares have more gains to go in the near term.
articles._zh_headline: 美国银行顶级分析师解释为何 Sandisk 在飙升 4,755% 后仍有更大上涨空间
articles._zh_summary: Sandisk（纳斯达克股票代码：SNDK）是今年标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克 100 指数中表现最好的公司。自 1 月份以来已飙升 800%，在过去 12 个月内上涨了 4,755%。这一激增使其从西部数据（纳斯达克股票代码：WDC）的一家小型分拆公司发展成为一家价值 3,230 亿美元的公司。美国银行分析师在最近的一份报告中预测，该股还有更大的上涨空间。美国银行高级分析师瓦姆西·莫汉 (Wamsi Mohan) 认为，Sandisk 的股价短期内还有更多上涨空间。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Micron Is Up 285% So Far This Year. Will It Surge or Crash After Earnings?
articles.summary: Micron stock has jumped by 285% this year, helped by the ongoing memory chip shortage. Its earnings reports will be crucial.
articles._summary: MU stock has soared this year, mirroring the gains of companies in the memory industry like Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Western Digital (NASDAQ: WDC ) . This surge has accelerated because of the ongoing supply shortage, which has led to a surge in prices, a trend that may continue over time. As a result, its revenue growth has accelerated, with the second quarter figure rising by 75% QoQ to $23 billion. This increase was up by 196% from the same period last year.
articles._zh_headline: 美光今年迄今已上涨 285%。盈利后会飙升还是崩盘？
articles._zh_summary: MU 股价今年飙升，反映了三星电子、SK 海力士和西部数据（纳斯达克股票代码：WDC）等内存行业公司的收益。由于持续的供应短缺，这种飙升加速了，导致价格飙升，这种趋势可能会随着时间的推移而持续下去。因此，其收入增长加速，第二季度收入环比增长 75%，达到 230 亿美元。这一增幅比去年同期增长了196%。
